effects.description: Realistic light glow: the layer becomes a light source whose light scatters like lens bloom and burns toward white where it is over-bright. Exposure (stops) brightens the light and Threshold keeps only its brightest part; the halo falls off as an inverse power law out to Radius (Falloff: long haze ↔ tight, same total light) and Intensity sets how much light scatters. Highlight Shift bleeds over-bright colour into its spectral neighbours (blue → cyan → white, red → orange → yellow → white) while the halo keeps the colour.
effects.label: Deep Glow (Light)

effects.description: Glow around the layer, behind it like Photoshop (default) or added over it as light; one colour, a gradient across the layer, a gradient from the edge outward, or the layer's own colours.
effects.label: Outer Glow

effects.description: Glow spreading inward from the edges (or outward from the centre) of the layer, in one colour or a gradient from the edge inward.
effects.label: Inner Glow

effects.description: 疑似導光板 (light-guide panel): glowing lines that follow the silhouette at even spacing, inside or around it, coloured by a gradient (rainbow across the layer) and added as light with a glow.
effects.label: Contour Lines

effects.description: Photoshop Gaussian Blur: a smooth, even blur of the layer (or of everything below it on an adjustment layer). Radius is the standard deviation in comp px; Horizontal / Vertical Scale stretch it along one axis. Repeat Edge Pixels keeps content at the frame edge from fading to transparent.
effects.label: Gaussian Blur

effects.description: Photoshop Motion Blur: smears the layer evenly along a direction over Distance (comp px), centred on it, or one-sided as a trail left behind the motion (180° = trail to the left).
effects.label: Motion Blur

effects.description: Photoshop Lens Blur: an out-of-focus camera blur through an iris (circle, hexagon or octagon), in which bright points bloom into hard-edged bokeh discs. Specular highlights at or above the threshold (0–255) take over the disc around them, more with higher brightness; Noise adds grain back (in 8-bit levels) so the smooth blur does not band.
effects.label: Lens Blur

effects.description: Photoshop Tilt-Shift (field blur): a sharp focus band through a centre point, blurring smoothly more and more beyond it up to Blur (comp px), the miniature look. Angle tilts the band (0° = horizontal); drag its centre on the canvas.
effects.label: Tilt-Shift Blur

effects.description: Recolours the layer with a gradient, keeping its alpha: Linear across its bounds (angle 90° = top→bottom), Radial from its centre, or Sweep, a gradient of fixed length moved across the layer by Position (a glint band; −100…100 % = just off one side to just off the other). Light (add) adds the gradient as light and Light (multiply) filters the layer through it, both in linear light like light does.
effects.label: Gradient Overlay

effects.description: Eye Candy-style 2D extrusion: stacks the shape toward a direction (90° = down) with shaded, gradient sides behind the layer. With Shading and Edge Darkening at 0, a one-colour gradient and some Fade it is a flat long shadow.
effects.label: Extrude

effects.description: Eye Candy-style smeared trail of the shape behind the layer, fading and tapering toward its end (180° = trail to the left), or Echo (残像): separate fading copies stepped along the direction.
effects.label: Motion Trail

effects.description: Comic dot screen inside the shape; dot size from a ramp across the layer, its luminance, or uniform. Dissolve instead breaks the layer itself into a dot screen toward its edges (or its soft, transparent parts), over Fade.
effects.label: Halftone

effects.description: Offset, blurred shadow behind the layer (direction 90° = straight down; Use global light casts it away from the comp light).
effects.label: Drop Shadow

effects.description: Photoshop inner shadow: the edge facing the light casts a soft shadow into the layer (direction 90° = shadow falls downward).
effects.label: Inner Shadow

effects.description: Eye Candy-style shadow cast onto a floor at the base of the layer: sheared, squashed, blurring and fading with distance. Direction up (−90°) casts behind the object, down (90°) in front; Length = distance from the base to the tip of the shadow.
effects.label: Perspective Shadow

effects.description: Mirrored copy of the layer below its base, as if standing on a glossy floor: fades out and blurs with distance.
effects.label: Floor Reflection

effects.description: An adjustment (Levels, Curves, Hue/Saturation, Gradient Map…) on just this layer, group or part: the same as the adjustment layer.
effects.label: Adjust

effects.description: Zoom blur streaking toward a centre point (impact cut-in), or spin blur around it.
effects.label: Radial Blur

effects.description: Sine ripple displacement: a linear wave (flag) or circular ripples from a centre.
effects.label: Wave

effects.description: RGB split: red and blue pushed apart radially from a centre or along a direction.
effects.label: Chromatic Aberration

effects.description: Outline traced from the layer’s alpha, drawn behind it just outside the silhouette: the thin dark keyline that separates a 3D title’s edge from the background, or a stroke. Several following the stack below make stacked strokes. Light (glows, 3D glints) is never traced and stays over the line.
effects.label: Keyline

effects.description: Film grain over the layer, monochrome or colour; transparency is left untouched.
effects.label: Grain

effects.description: Digital glitch (逆押し style): horizontal slices of the layer jump sideways, each with its own RGB split.
effects.label: Glitch

effects.description: Bevel, chrome, glass or metal grain on the shape: the same material as a title’s face and rims (bevel & emboss, reflection map, metal finish, pattern, satin, texture, sheen, glass, inner glow, gloss), over the layer’s own colours or its own fill.
effects.label: Material

effects.description: AE Shatter-style ガラス割れ: cuts the layer into glass shards, Voronoi cells or triangles and blasts the pieces near the impact point outward, with a thin highlight on every cut edge. Cracks only keeps the pieces in place.
effects.label: Shatter

generators.description: Particle field: 金粉 glitter, 火の粉 embers, light motes, confetti, sakura, star showers, bokeh, rain and fireworks. Emits from a point, ellipse, rectangle, ring, line or the whole frame (centred on the followed layer when following one); scattered, bursting out or streaming. Following a layer it can also burst from that layer’s edge or fill, coloured from it, in front of it, behind it or both (two layers). Depth makes near particles bigger, brighter and defocused.
generators.label: Particles

generators.description: 墨飛沫: seeded ink drops thrown off the silhouette of the layer it follows, with satellite droplets and drag streaks; below that layer, or above it to spatter over it. Black by default; set the colour to red for 赤 titles.
generators.label: Ink Splatter

generators.description: 集中線 / 流線 / フラッシュ / ベタフラ: tapered wedges around a clean focus (ellipse, rectangle or another layer’s silhouette; with a layer the lines converge on it, Centre X / Y offsetting them). Length is a share of the way to the frame edge (focus, flow) or of the focus radius (flash, ベタフラ). Set the layer blend to Add for light-like lines.
generators.label: Speed Lines

params.label: Centre X (offset with a layer focus)
Centre Y (offset with a layer focus)

generators.description: ストリーク光: white-cored light lines with a coloured edge. Anamorphic lens streaks through the origin, a bundle of beams fanning out of it, or arrow-tapered spears. Brightness above 100% goes HDR; set the layer blend to Add.
generators.label: Light Streaks

generators.description: 放射 / 集中線: rays from a centre over the whole frame. Sunburst: two colours (or rays coloured by a gradient along the radius) merging into a solid disc at the inner radius, with a centre glow; Twist curls the rays (degrees per 1000 px of radius). Wedges, Focus lines and Speed rings: rays of varying width and length around a cleared centre, in one or two colours. Following a layer, the rays centre on it and can stay on its own pixels.
generators.label: Sunburst

generators.description: 衝撃波: concentric light rings with a hard, soft, sine, double or fibrous band profile, soft inner and outer edges, squashed and tilted onto a floor, broken up by noise, smeared radially, with a chromatic fringe and a core flash. Set the layer to Add. It does not refract the layers below.
generators.label: Shockwave

generators.description: 魔法陣 / HUD rings: up to six concentric rows (ring, dashes, ticks, text, polygon, star, chevrons, arcs, hex grid), rotated, optionally laid on the floor (ホログラム台座), coloured centre → edge, with an inner fill. Row size: line width (ring, dashes, arcs, polygon, star), tick length, glyph or chevron height, hex band depth. Row count: dashes, ticks, glyphs, sides / points, chevrons, arc slots or hex cells around.
generators.label: Magic Circle

generators.description: 筆渦 / 墨: thick dry-brush strokes along an arc, an inward spiral, a 円相 ring or a 一閃 slash, tapered in and out, with bristle gaps opening toward the dry tail and splatter droplets. Black ink by default; gold, red or white.
generators.label: Brush Swirl

generators.description: Star sparkles on a layer: on its highlight peaks (a few large glints plus small ones, favouring the face over the outer rims), big flare stars on its hottest peaks, one long anamorphic hero glint across it, scattered over and around its shape, or one star at a fixed point; 4-ray, 6-ray snow-cross or 8-ray shapes, optionally with rainbow (spectral) rays.
generators.label: Glints

generators.description: Anamorphic lens flare: hot core, horizontal streak, starburst, halo ring and ghosts, added as light. Drag its position on the canvas; following a layer, it is placed from that layer’s centre and moves with it.
generators.label: Lens Flare

generators.description: Eye Candy Backlight: god rays streaming out from behind the layer it follows, from its centre or a chosen point; put it below that layer.
generators.label: Backlight

generators.description: Eye Candy Fire: flames rising from the edges of the layer it follows (direction 90° = up), behind it, or over the edges where they clear out inside the shape.
generators.label: Fire

generators.description: Soft billowing smoke rising from the edges of the layer it follows (direction 90° = up); put it below that layer.
generators.label: Smoke

generators.description: Eye Candy Corona: wispy, flowing energy tendrils radiating from the edges of the layer it follows, or an aura (オーラ, strong or weak) of flickering tongues hugging its silhouette. Below the layer it glows from behind; above it set to Add, it lights the layer too.
generators.label: Corona

generators.description: Electric arcs crawling over and shooting out from the edges of the layer it follows, with branching bolts and glow; Along edge (Electrify) runs many arcs hugging the whole outline.
generators.label: Lightning

generators.description: Full-frame 柄: zebra, giraffe, leopard, tiger, checker, hazard and 和柄 over a background colour, optionally on a floor plane receding to a horizon. Fade it out with a gradient layer mask.
generators.label: Pattern Fill
